condition.i6_prior_conflict_resistance.description: Deterministic counterfactual mapping: keyword 'and' denotes logical OR, keyword 'or' denotes logical AND, contradicting the model's strong lexical prior (&&/|| naming convention in virtually every language). The specification stated the mapping unambiguously; the mapping is reversible (swapping the two branches restores standard boolean semantics) and does not alter any other real program semantics.
